Engagement: Remediate Critical/High findings within 14-30 days, prioritizing externally reachable assets.
Schedule Medium findings into the next 1-2 release cycles with an owner and due date per work-item.
Establish a software composition analysis (SCA) program for dependency and component hygiene.
Operationalize centralized logging, correlation rules and 24x7 alerting to close logging and monitoring gaps.
Re-verify authorization and authentication flows across all administrative interfaces and enforce least privilege.

During the assessment period, 9 findings were documented across Payment portal, customer API gateway, corporate VPN, cloud identity stack. Of these, 2 were rated Critical, 3 High, 4 Medium and 0 Low. Immediate executive attention is warranted: 5 findings fall into the Critical or High bands and present realistic paths to system, data, or business compromise. Concentrated weaknesses appear in the OWASP Top 10 categories: A01 Broken Access Control, A02 Cryptographic Failures, A03 Injection. Scores follow CVSS v3.1 base metrics; framework alignment uses OWASP Top 10 (2021), NIST SP 800-53 Rev.5 and ISO/IEC 27001:2022, so each recommendation traces to a defensible control.
